title: Apple unveils new Siri AI with on-screen awareness and #apple #siriaifeatures #aitechnology
description:
Apple unveiled a new version of Siri featuring on-screen awareness and enhanced contextual understanding across apps. Users can now ask Siri questions about content visible on their screens, get details like photo locations with directions, and retrieve specific information such as recipes shared months ago.

This update marks a significant improvement in Siri’s practical utility by integrating personal context into interactions, closing the gap with similar Android features. While not groundbreaking, the changes reflect years of user demand for a smarter, more helpful virtual assistant.

Enhanced contextual AI in Siri demonstrates Apple's commitment to improving user experience through smarter integration, positioning Siri as a more relevant tool in everyday tasks and communication.
